exclusion_reason: Range/block streaming with prefetch and async guest I/O is implemented: the plan orders every content block deterministically, splits a prefetch set from a lazily-streamed deferred set, and a guest read of an absent deferred block returns a non-blocking pending descriptor. The benchmark stays red because measuring time-to-interactive and confirming zero frame stall on the absent-block read needs the absent browser streaming runtime.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the fixture reaches interactive partly unfetched with no frame stall on absent-block read.
active_gate_evidence: test/package.test.mjs asserts the plan splits prefetch from deferred, interactive starts partly unfetched, an absent-block read is non-blocking and pending, and the plan is byte-deterministic across runs.
procedure: Start the fixture with a declared unfetched set.
Read an absent block synchronously from the guest and measure the frame impact.
pass_criterion: Absent-block read causes no frame stall.
